nodes.summary: Event-sourcing reducer: pure apply_* functions that fold cluster events (tasks, instances, runners, links, topology, downloads) into the immutable State.

nodes.summary: Unit tests for apply_instance_link_created/deleted and instance-deletion link stripping in the state reducer.

nodes.summary: Unit tests for node download progress reduction into state.

nodes.name: test_apply_runner_deleted.py
nodes.summary: Unit tests for runner shutdown and status-update reduction into state.

nodes.name: events.py
nodes.summary: Discriminated union of cluster events (TaggedModel) exchanged over the event bus, plus indexed and forwarder wrapper events.

nodes.name: _make_text_gen_task
nodes.summary: Builds a TextGeneration task fixture used by the stream-cleanup tests.

nodes.name: test_close_streams_for_deleted_instance

nodes.name: _is_rdma_ctl_enabled
nodes.summary: Checks whether RDMA ctl is enabled from the node info.

nodes.name: event_apply
nodes.summary: Top-level reducer dispatch: applies an event to the current state by event type.

nodes.name: apply
nodes.summary: Applies an ordered sequence of events to produce the new state.

nodes.name: apply_node_download_progress
nodes.summary: Folds node download progress events into the state's download tracking.

nodes.name: apply_task_deleted
nodes.summary: Removes a deleted task from state.

nodes.name: apply_task_status_updated
nodes.summary: Updates a task's status in state.

nodes.name: apply_task_failed
nodes.summary: Records a task failure with error type and message in state.

nodes.name: apply_instance_created
nodes.summary: Adds a newly created instance to state.

nodes.name: apply_instance_deleted
nodes.summary: Removes an instance and cleans up related links and runners from state.

nodes.name: apply_instance_link_created
nodes.summary: Adds an instance link between prefill and decode instances.

nodes.name: apply_instance_link_deleted
nodes.summary: Removes an instance link from state.

nodes.name: apply_runner_status_updated
nodes.summary: Updates a runner's status in state.

nodes.name: apply_node_timed_out
nodes.summary: Handles a node timeout: removes the node's instances, runners, tasks, and links from state.

nodes.name: apply_node_gathered_info
nodes.summary: Reduces gathered node info (identity, performance, network, thunderbolt) into state.

nodes.name: apply_topology_edge_deleted
nodes.summary: Removes a topology edge from state.

nodes.name: apply_custom_model_card_added
nodes.summary: Adds a custom model card to the state's model cards.

nodes.name: apply_custom_model_card_deleted
nodes.summary: Removes a custom model card from state.

nodes.name: test_apply_node_download_progress
nodes.summary: Asserts a single node download progress event reduces into state.

nodes.name: test_apply_two_node_download_progress
nodes.summary: Asserts download progress for two nodes is tracked independently.

nodes.name: BaseEvent
nodes.summary: Base tagged event with an event_id and internal master timestamp.

nodes.name: TaskCreated
nodes.summary: Event emitted when a task is created; carries task_id and the full Task payload.

nodes.name: TaskAcknowledged
nodes.summary: Event acknowledging that a task was received.

nodes.name: TaskDeleted
nodes.summary: Event emitted when a task is deleted from the cluster.

nodes.name: TaskStatusUpdated
nodes.summary: Event carrying a task's updated status.

nodes.name: TaskFailed
nodes.summary: Event carrying task failure error type and message.

nodes.name: InstanceCreated
nodes.summary: Event emitted when a new model instance is created; carries the Instance payload.

nodes.name: InstanceDeleted
nodes.summary: Event emitted when an instance is deleted.

nodes.name: RunnerStatusUpdated
nodes.summary: Event carrying a runner's updated status.

nodes.name: NodeTimedOut
nodes.summary: Event emitted when a node times out.

nodes.name: NodeGatheredInfo
nodes.summary: Event carrying gathered node information (identity, performance, network).

nodes.name: NodeDownloadProgress
nodes.summary: Event carrying download progress for a node.

nodes.name: ChunkGenerated
nodes.summary: Event carrying a generated chunk for a command.

nodes.name: InputChunkReceived
nodes.summary: Event carrying an input image chunk received for a command.

nodes.name: TopologyEdgeCreated
nodes.summary: Event emitted when a topology edge (connection) is created.

nodes.name: TopologyEdgeDeleted
nodes.summary: Event emitted when a topology edge is deleted.

nodes.name: CustomModelCardAdded
nodes.summary: Event carrying a custom model card added by the user.

nodes.name: CustomModelCardDeleted
nodes.summary: Event carrying the model ID of a deleted custom model card.

nodes.name: TraceEventData
nodes.summary: Frozen model describing a single trace span (name, timings, rank, category).

nodes.name: TracesCollected
nodes.summary: Event carrying collected trace spans for a task and rank.

nodes.name: TracesMerged
nodes.summary: Event carrying merged trace spans for a task.

nodes.name: InstanceLinkCreated
nodes.summary: Event carrying a new prefill/decode instance link.

nodes.name: InstanceLinkDeleted
nodes.summary: Event carrying the ID of a deleted instance link.

nodes.name: IndexedEvent
nodes.summary: An event indexed by the master with a globally unique index.

nodes.name: GlobalForwarderEvent
nodes.summary: Forwarder event wrapping an event with origin node and session for serialisation.

nodes.name: LocalForwarderEvent
nodes.summary: Forwarder event wrapping an event with origin system and session for serialisation.
